note: The Commonwealth Bank, which took over Nauru's banking when Bendigo Bank left and serves it through two agencies: its Streamline Basic, the everyday account for individuals there, has no monthly account fee and no over-the-counter fee at the agency.

sources.title: CommBank, CommBank Nauru
sources.said: Streamline Basic, an everyday account for individual customers, with access to NetBank and Debit Mastercard ... Following the exit of the existing banking provider, and the recent announcement of a Treaty between the Governments of Australia and Nauru, CommBank will establish banking operations in Nauru.

sources.title: CommBank, Streamline Basic flyer (Nauru)
sources.said: You can transact over the counter at the Agency at Nauru - fee-free. ... There’s a $0 monthly fee ... Monthly account fee Nil
